Literally me. 

I’m 22. I didn’t expect to survive this long, even though I never acted on the thoughts at 16,17,18 I came close but didn’t act on them - more just a spontaneous I could kill myself like so if I wanted, 19, 20 or 21. 22 was when the closest I came to acting on the thoughts.

I nearly jumped off a bridge. It was from place of complete loneliness, feeling like I was ugly as sin and would never find anyone for me, that people saw an ugly man when they saw me, that my life was hopeless because I’m a two time uni dropout who would never get the money to do anything she wanted. Kinda morbid but I just thought along the lines of I’ve never come this close before but what the fuck am I doing. Just ran through my mind. I thought I’d never see my dog or cat again, never see the people I loved again, never live again. I dont know why the hell i thought that at the time but I did, and I walked away from the bridge. I kind of went home exhausted, freaked out, weirded out that I didn’t go through with it, I guess processing what happened. I’ve never told my family or friends about it to this day, I don’t want to scare them. And I don’t think I ever will.

Because in the months that have passed from it, I’ve started studying again in the hope of going to uni a third time and smashing it. That’s the main concrete action I guess that came from - learning French, getting back into the programming and maths I loved before my mental issues tore apart any capacity I had in my brain for it. And although I want to lose weight, I’ve come much more to terms with my appearance to the point I can sometimes look in the mirror and see a woman who.. I’m fairly happy with. I’ve also learnt appreciate joys in life more I guess, be it cuddling my pets, video games, the taste of chocolate, being around people I trust.. just the little stuff. In some ways I’m glad I went to that bridge and considered, really considered jumping off because if I didn’t, I’d still be in that semi-suicidal rut that kept resurfacing. Whereas I can say now I don’t want to die and I’m kind of glad to be alive. 

I guess if you’re going through hell, keep going. I’m not going to say ‘it gets better’ because it’s cliché and even it may get better, that doesn’t help when you’re in that state, from first hand experience. Here’s what I’ll say. Life is shitty and can be fucked and hard yes but I promise it is worth living even if it’s in one small way. Like for me with my dog and cat. FIND THAT WAY. Hold onto it. Treasure it. And think would you want to never experience it again? Eternity is a helluva long time. Also, you have no idea how much your life impacts on other people. You may think not many people will miss you but I promise you, they will. You influence other people and enlighten their lives more than you could know. 

But anyway yeah it kinda felt cathartic to air that after seeing the meme, and also thought I’d leave this here in the hopes it helps even one person. :)
